title: PedEdit pedigree JSON document
description: Lossless JSON export of a PedEdit pedigree. The document root is the envelope; the importer also accepts a bare Pedigree object. See docs/pedigree-json-format.md.

parentOf.description: Keys are partnership ids, values are the ids of that partnership's children.

pinnedPositions.description: Manual drag overrides keyed by individual id, in canvas pixels.

tags.description: Tag definitions in display order. Quadrant tags take their sector from this order.

chartTitle.description: Title drawn above the chart and in exports. Absent means the pedigree's name; an empty string means no title.

presymptomatic.description: Asymptomatic or presymptomatic carrier (NSGC): a vertical line through the symbol. The editor never sets it together with carrier.

evaluations.description: Evaluations and test results (NSGC), written under the symbol as E+ (detail), numbered E1, E2 when there are several.

proband.description: Proband arrow with a P (NSGC). Normally exactly one individual.

consultand.description: Consultand arrow, without the P (NSGC): the person seeking counselling. Someone who is also the proband is drawn as the proband.

familyHistoryUnknown.description: Family history not known (NSGC): a ? above the symbol.

lifeStatus.description: Pregnancy or pregnancy loss. Absent means born. Such an individual has no partners or children.

adopted.description: Adoption brackets round the symbol (NSGC). "in": adopted into the family shown, dashed line to the adoptive parents. "out": placed for adoption, solid line to the biological parents.

age.description: The individual's age as free text, e.g. "50s" or "d. 72", shown under the symbol in place of the DOB. Not an age of onset.

descendantsHidden.description: Everyone below this individual is left out of the drawing and exports (not removed from the data).

tags.description: Ids of tags from Pedigree.tags applied to this individual.

onset.description: Age of onset of the affected status, free text such as "45y" or "40s". Used only while affected is true.

tagOnset.description: Age of onset per condition: id of a quadrant tag this individual carries, to free text as for onset.

consanguinityLabel.description: Text written above the double line, e.g. third cousins: the degree of relationship when the drawing does not show it. Drawn only when the line is double.

childless.description: Childless couple mark under the couple line (NSGC): two bars for infertility, one bar for no children by choice. Only on a partnership with no children.

childlessReason.description: Optional reason shown under the childless mark, e.g. vasectomy.

twins.description: Twin sets among this partnership's children. Each member is in at most one set.

ended.description: The relationship no longer exists (separated, divorced): two short strokes across the couple line.

result.description: +, - or u after the E. Absent: no result recorded.

detail.description: Short text shown in parentheses, e.g. BRCA1 c.5266dupC.

documented.description: Documented evaluation: a * at the symbol's lower right.

members.description: Ids of children of the partnership, in drawing order.

zygosity.description: Monozygotic members must have the same sex.

label.description: Full name shown in the legend.

abbrev.description: Short canvas text for text-style tags. Defaults to label.

ClinicalDetails.description: Clinical key fields (NSGC 2008, Fig. 1 instructions). All free text; absent or empty means not recorded. Shown in the key when filled; de-identified exports drop them.

recordedOn.description: Date of intake or last update, normally ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

maternalAncestry.description: Ancestry of the maternal side, relative to the proband.

paternalAncestry.description: Ancestry of the paternal side, relative to the proband.

nameLabels.description: How a name too long for its slot is shown on the canvas: wrapped onto two lines, or cut to one line. Absent means "wrap". Exports always wrap.

layoutWidth.description: How wide the automatic layout may be: no wider than the widest generation, or up to two slots wider so children sit more directly under their parents. Absent means "minimal". Applies to the canvas and to exports.

showNumbers.description: Draw each person's pedigree number (generation in Roman numerals, then place in the row, e.g. "II-3") before their name, on the canvas and in figure exports. The numbers are computed from the layout, not stored. Absent means false.

relationshipLabels.description: Write the relationship (e.g. "first cousins") above every consanguineous couple's double line that can be named and has no consanguinityLabel of its own. Absent means false.
